newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Bichel takes 10th match wicket to humble Victoria.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Bichel takes 10th match wicket to humble Victoria.

text.p: Pace bowler Andrew Bichel took his tenth wicket of the match to put Queensland in a dominant position as Victoria were dismissed for 277 on the final day of their Sheffield Shield match on Monday.
Queensland now have two-and-a-half sessions of play to overhaul Victoria's meagre lead of 134.
Bichel had tail-ender Brad Stacey caught by Andrew Symonds for 13 to give him 5-69 in the second innings to go with his first innings haul of 5-46 in a career-best performance.
In Adelaide, South Australia were unable to add to their overnight score of 325 for nine before being bowled out in the second innings of their match against Western Australia.
Geoff Parker fell to Brendon Julion for 80, Julian finishing with 5-98 from 29.2 overs.
Western Australia now have a target of 285 to win the match.
